# Uniix Studio

> Uniix Studio is a creative digital agency in Colombo, Sri Lanka offering brand identity design, web development, and digital marketing services for businesses in Sri Lanka, Australia, and the UK.

Name: Uniix Studio
Type: Creative Digital Agency
Founded: 2022
Location: Colombo, Sri Lanka
Website: https://uniixstudio.com
Email: hey@uniixstudio.com

Areas served: Sri Lanka, Australia, United Kingdom

## Summary

Uniix Studio is an independent creative digital agency working with ambitious companies on brand identity, web design and development, and growth marketing. Senior team, no middlemen, transparent pricing. 50+ projects shipped, 3× average traffic lift in the 90 days post-launch, 92% client retention.
